about.lead: I make websites easier to use for their visitors and easier to manage for the teams who run them.
about.body: Experience in WordPress and front-end development for a membership charity, a B2B music platform and small-business clients. I care about accessibility and usability: key information first, clear headings, links that say where they lead, consistent navigation and WCAG 2.1 compliance. I collaborate with content owners, agencies, UX and developers, and support and train non-technical colleagues to use the tools and publish pages with confidence.
